text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A 1200m turf blitz. The front fills up in 
the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In a flash, the Umamusume blaze past the 
goalpost. In this place where everyone 
competes in speed...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I look utterly unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Don't hang your head just yet.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King...-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"We are still on the turf. We still have a 
'responsibility.'"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you truly wish to learn from me, brace 
yourself and watch me until the very end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Behold King's true form.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
King Halo-san!? This is the Winner's 
Circle, you know!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Strictly speaking, I am an Umamusume 
who shouldn't be standing here today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, there is something I must tell them 
as myself.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You lost in the end anyway, King Halo! 
Just give it up already~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
King's run today really did lack its usual 
luster. Almost like she's past her prime, 
or something...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Coming all the way to the winner's circle 
just to make a scene is pathetic. Not 
throwing a selfish tantrum would be much 
better for the rookies, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Listen closely and take this to heart!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I hereby grant you all the privilege of 
listening to King's words. This is the 
world of competition."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In other words, results are everything. 
That makes me... nothing more than a loser 
whose dream of victory was crushed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I take pride in having run that 
race! I have no regrets about being 
selfish whatsoever!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You tell me to be ashamed of myself, but I 
will not be ashamed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because this—taking on this very 
challenge— is the most true-to-myself 
thing I could do!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm proud of myself for making the choice 
that feels true to me! No matter what 
anyone says, this is my path!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Those are the words of the King. Now, feel 
free to shower the victorious lady with 
your blessings.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...You're so cool, King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There's no way I could imitate that. 
Is that... what it means to be a king?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Did you not want to see it? King in 
this state, that is.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I betrayed your expectations 
in an unsightly way... and ended up 
hurting you."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No! That's not true at all!! Never...!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see... But whether that is flattery or 
not, what I say and the actions I take 
will not change.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If the day comes when I compete against 
you again, I will crush you with 
everything I have."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I won't hold back against anyone, even if 
it gets messy. —Because that is also my 
way of showing respect to those I 
challenge."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. When that time comes, I'll be 
counting on you...!
choice_data_list:
...Do you know how to paint your "ideal" 
now?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course. The answer is 
already... right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, Kawakami Princess 
came to me with a certain proposal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
King-san asked me, 'Can you hold your head 
high with pride?'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Is this an action I can take pride in? Is 
this truly like me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I don't want to be 
selfish; I want to charge ahead true to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No matter how I am seen by anyone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. About the Fan Appreciation 
Festival next month... I'd really love to 
perform on this stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Kawakami Princess showed me was a 
certain stage plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""Looking back on last year's Tiara route! 
A joint talk show featuring radiant 
Umamusume!""

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who competed together last 
year... and their fans will apparently be 
gathering as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to take the stage for such a 
reason would be unbefitting of a princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze was resolute, as if she had made 
up her mind about something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet deep within her eyes, she was 
wavering. Trembling slightly, but rallying 
herself to grow stronger.
